description_zh: 实时统计座席通话数据
kebab_example: aliyun dyvmsapi cloud-agent-monitor-statistics --enterprise-id 7000002 --fields example-string --cnos 1111 --is-use-gno 0 --gno WH123 --limit 10 --offset 0 --start-hour 0 --end-hour 23 --is-need-queue-name 0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CloudAgentMonitorStatistics

parameters.description_en: The fields for real-time queue statistics. To specify multiple fields, separate them with a comma (,). If this parameter is omitted, all fields are returned by default.
parameters.description_zh: 统计项名称；取队列实时统计的统计字段名称，多个队列统计项之间使用英文逗号","分隔，默认查询所有统计项
parameters.help_en: The fields for real-time queue statistics. To specify multiple fields, separate them with a comma (,). If this parameter is omitted, all fields are returned by default
parameters.help_zh: 统计项名称；取队列实时统计的统计字段名称，多个队列统计项之间使用英文逗号","分隔，默认查询所有统计项
parameters.name: fields

parameters.description_en: The IDs of the agents to query. To specify multiple agents, separate their IDs with a comma (,). If you omit this parameter, statistics for all agents in the account are returned by default.
parameters.description_zh: 说明：根据座席工号查询指定座席的统计项名称支持按照多个座席工号进行查询，多个座席工号之间使用英文逗号","分隔，默认查询账户下所有座席的统计信息
parameters.help_en: The IDs of the agents to query. To specify multiple agents, separate their IDs with a comma (,). If you omit this parameter, statistics for all agents in the account are returned by default
parameters.help_zh: 说明：根据座席工号查询指定座席的统计项名称支持按照多个座席工号进行查询，多个座席工号之间使用英文逗号","分隔，默认查询账户下所有座席的统计信息
parameters.name: cnos

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to query statistics by outbound group. Valid values are 0 (disabled, default) and 1 (enabled).
parameters.description_zh: 是否需要外呼组查询；说明：0 关闭外呼组查询，1 开启外呼组查询。默认为关闭状态
parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query statistics by outbound group. Valid values are 0 (disabled, default) and 1 (enabled)
parameters.help_zh: 是否需要外呼组查询；说明：0 关闭外呼组查询，1 开启外呼组查询。默认为关闭状态
parameters.name: is_use_gno

parameters.description_en: The IDs of the outbound groups to query. To specify multiple outbound groups, separate their IDs with a comma (,). If this parameter is omitted, statistics for all agents in the account are returned by default. This parameter applies only when IsUseGno is set to 1.
parameters.description_zh: 说明：根据外呼组编号查询指定座席的统计项名称支持按照多个外呼组编号进行查询，多个座席工号之间使用英文逗号","分隔，默认查询账户下所有座席的统计信息
parameters.help_en: The IDs of the outbound groups to query. To specify multiple outbound groups, separate their IDs with a comma (,). If this parameter is omitted, statistics for all agents in the account are returned by default. This parameter applies only when IsUseGno is set to 1
parameters.help_zh: 说明：根据外呼组编号查询指定座席的统计项名称支持按照多个外呼组编号进行查询，多个座席工号之间使用英文逗号","分隔，默认查询账户下所有座席的统计信息

parameters.description_en: The number of entries to return per page. The value must be between 1 and 500. The default is 10.

parameters.description_en: The starting position for the query, used with Limit for pagination. For example, if you set Offset to 50 and Limit to 10, the API returns entries 51 through 60. The default is 0.
parameters.description_zh: 查询页码数的起始条数；正整数，默认值是0；与limit同步使用，例：offset=50,limit=10,表示查询第6页，每页10条数据，即总记录的第51-60条数据
